key_points: Headlines consist almost entirely of options chain data (calls/puts across strikes/expirations) – pure trading noise
Two generic third-party valuation/forecast articles (Simply Wall Street, Stocks Down Under) carry no primary information
No earnings, guidance, M&A, regulatory, product, or management news present
No material change to long-term investment thesis for a risk-aware holder
Short-term options activity irrelevant to fundamental value assessment
